**가문.** 조양 임씨 집안. 겨울마다 바깥 통로의 셔터와 잠금장치를 번갈아 점검해 온 집안이다.

**관계.** 밤 점검 때 이웃 가족과 순찰 구간을 번갈아 서고, 불빛을 켜지 않는 규칙을 어린 사람들에게 일러 준다.

Pump technician Im Chowon is the adopted son of the missing Im Hajun. In Seongsu 1-ga 2-dong, she takes over the pump maintenance records and cross-checks the seal on the original box, verified at the shift after the disappearance, against the Council of Elders' records. The maintenance training she received from Im Hajun was never completed.

**Life.** Generation of 2126. Grew up beside the pumps. What she learned from Im Hajun was pump maintenance skills, not a share in the O family's affairs. Her rank is Teacher. At the shift after the disappearance in winter 2125, she verified the seal on the original box. The verified fact was recorded in the witness column of the three will sheets. In 2126, O Gyeongjae, as Stationmaster of Samseong Station, checked the pump-maintenance records Im Hajun left behind. Im Chowon remains a pump technician at the opening.

**Office.** Rank: Teacher. Title: Pump Engineer, Adopted Child of Im Hajun. Livelihood nickname: Pump Technician.

**Anecdote.** At the shift after the disappearance, Im Chowon did not open the copy box. Only the seal on the original box was verified. That verification was recorded in the witness column of the three will sheets.

**House.** Yecheon Im clan. A teaching family that has long taught children reading, writing and winter rules.

**Relations.** Adopted son of Im Hajun. Pump technical alliance with O Gyeongjae. Competes with Han Somi for the Chief succession.

2126년 세대. 오경재는 삼성 지하 통로의 마지막 당직 수습생이었다. 오씨 가문 출신으로서 셔터 점검표와 연료·식량 장부를 이어받아 삼성 역장을 맡았다. 신사동·논현1동·대치2동 구간을 오가며 통로 순찰 기록을 모았고, 밤 불빛을 늘리자는 요구는 받아들이지 않았다. 기계 몸 수리 기록의 원본 상자는 이웃 구간 담당과 함께 봉인해 두기로 했다.
관직. 품계 역장. 직함은 역장.
일화. 취임 직후, 임하준의 세 유언을 함에서 꺼내 역 회의실에 공개했다.

관계. 이웃 구간 정비 담당과 부품 사정을 나눈다. 연료·식량 배분으로 이웃 역과 다툴 때는 공개 장부를 기준으로 삼는다.
